name: Carrot transferFrom skips the allowance for self-whitelisted callers
summary: Carrot's transferFrom skips the allowance check when the caller is in _isExcludedFromFee, and its public _beforeTransfer path let the attacker add itself to that set; it then moved holders' CARROT to itself and sold it into the CARROT/USDT pair.
notes: Reset: the attacker's transReward made the token call the pool contract 0x6863b549 (named by initPool, 0xd7628013) to make the attacker the pool's owner, which _beforeTransfer reads to exempt the caller from the allowance. That call passes the pool's check only because the pool whitelisted the token (0x23cdc2f0, block 21729794, 68 blocks after the token's deployment), the last change that made the path usable (rule 8). The token has no trading gate; the liquidity added and the startTime set just before the exploit are live trading state. Loss is the pair's USDT; the CARROT is valued at nothing (rule 12).
